remarks: Welcome to this charming rental located in the desirable Glenbrook area of Stamford. Boasting 2BR 2BTH, this property invites you to experience comfort and coziness in abundance. Enjoy the copious amounts of natural light pouring in from large, generous windows, complementing the beautiful hardwood floors. Beneficial utilities include heat, hot-water, trash, and a dedicated parking spot. Conveniently located, this home places you to nearby shopping, restaurants, train station and public transportation. Become part of this Glenbrook community and enjoy the warmth of this lovely property. Surely, you wouldn't want to miss out on this.
